## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (e.g. `feat: add program filters`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated for the change
- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` pass locally
- [ ] `npm run db:test` passes (if the database changed)
- [ ] No secrets, API keys or `.env.local` values committed
